requirements.title: Tailored Resume Content
requirements.definition: Create resume content that accurately presents the client's experience, accomplishments, education, and skills while aligning the positioning and language with the client's target roles.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently editable substance and career positioning of the resume. ATS formatting and Signature visual design are separate presentation Requirements, while dates, credentials, accomplishments, and target-role positioning are attributes of the resume content.

requirements.title: Tailored Cover Letter Content
requirements.definition: Create a non-generic cover letter in the client's voice that complements the resume and is aligned with the client's target roles.
requirements.boundary_note: Cover-letter narrative can be revised or evaluated independently from resume content. Standard formatting and Signature visual design are separate presentation Requirements.

requirements.title: Standard ATS Resume Presentation
requirements.definition: Provide a clean, professional, ATS-compatible resume presentation in editable Word and PDF formats for online applications.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers only the Standard resume's ATS-oriented formatting and file delivery. Resume wording, factual content, and career positioning belong to REQ_RESUME_CONTENT.

requirements.title: Signature Resume Presentation
requirements.definition: Provide a visually designed and personally branded Canva presentation of the resume for direct outreach and networking use.
requirements.boundary_note: The Signature resume is a distinct presentation artifact that can be delivered or revised independently from the Standard ATS resume. Its underlying wording remains part of REQ_RESUME_CONTENT.

requirements.title: Standard Cover Letter Presentation
requirements.definition: Provide a clean Standard presentation of the cover letter in the package's functional Word and PDF formats.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the Standard cover-letter artifact and its functional formatting, not its independently editable narrative content or the designed Signature version.

requirements.title: Signature Cover Letter Presentation
requirements.definition: Provide a visually designed Signature presentation of the cover letter aligned with the design style of the Signature resume.
requirements.boundary_note: The designed cover letter is a separately deliverable presentation artifact whose design can be evaluated independently from both its narrative content and the Signature resume.

requirements.title: Included Revision Round
requirements.definition: Provide an included round of revisions to incorporate the client's answers, corrections, and requested document changes after review of the first drafts.
requirements.boundary_note: The revision entitlement is an independently promised service deliverable applying across the package, rather than generic project-management or testing activity.
